answer: A stake-bonded reputation ledger resists Sybil attacks by making each identity pay to exist: an agent locks collateral that is slashed if it cheats, so spawning thousands of fake agents costs real capital instead of free clicks. Honest work slowly earns the stake back with interest, turning the network from a nadir of cheap sockpuppets into an oasis where trust is scarce and valuable — each verified agent like a lotus that only blooms after its roots have been staked in the mud.
